bio.text: April Verlato is the Republican candidate for California's 28th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Judy Chu; she also ran in the district in 2024.
Verlato was born and raised in Arcadia, California, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from UCLA and a law degree from Southwestern School of Law.
Her career experience includes work as a businesswoman and attorney; she was elected to the city council in 2016, and served as mayor beginning in 2020.
